name: Plaid
category: Financial data connectivity and payment initiation APIs for banking, lending, and personal finance applications.
self_serve_or_gated: self-serve (free/trial signup) - Developers can create a free account on the Plaid Dashboard to obtain API keys and access a Sandbox environment. A 'Limited Production service' allows up to 200 API calls with live data for free trials, and Free Trial plans are available for new US/Canada teams. Production access is requested via the Dashboard, with pricing based on usage and product, often negotiated for higher volumes.
api_surface: REST (JSON over HTTP), broad. Covers Auth, Balance, Identity, Transactions, Investments, Liabilities, Income, Payments, and more. An OpenAPI definition file is available. A 'Local MCP server' is provided for building and testing, including features for AI coding assistants.
buildability_verdict: yes - Plaid offers a comprehensive REST API, client libraries, an OpenAPI specification, and a CLI designed for AI agents. The 'Local MCP server' explicitly supports AI coding assistants with features like documentation search and test data generation. The primary consideration for an AI agent toolkit would be managing user consent via Plaid Link for accessing sensitive financial data.
evidence: https://plaid.com/docs/api/overview/, https://plaid.com/docs/quickstart/, https://plaid.com/docs/api/authentication/, https://plaid.com/docs/api/oauth/, https://plaid.com/docs/resources/, https://plaid.com/pricing/, https://plaid.com/docs/account/pricing/, https://plaid.com/products/

name: Aircall
category: Cloud-based phone system and call center platform for sales, support, and customer relationship teams, offering call management, team collaboration, analytics, and AI-powered call insights.
auth_methods: Basic Authentication (API ID and API Token)
self_serve_or_gated: Self-serve for existing Aircall customers who can generate API keys from their dashboard. For technology partners building apps for the Aircall App Marketplace, there is a signup process to obtain OAuth client_id and client_secret.
api_surface: REST API with endpoints to retrieve and manage Aircall data (calls, contacts, users, numbers, teams). Supports Webhooks for real-time event notifications (e.g., call created, contact added). No mention of GraphQL or an existing MCP server.
buildability_verdict: yes, the Aircall API and Webhooks provide a robust foundation for building an AI agent toolkit today. It allows for monitoring call activity, performing in-call actions, and triggering workflows based on call events. Existing integrations with AI tools via platforms like Zapier further demonstrate its potential.

name: Twenty
category: Open-source customer relationship management (CRM) platform with built-in AI capabilities, including AI agents.
self_serve_or_gated: self-serve (free/trial signup for cloud platform, or self-host your own instance)
api_surface: REST and GraphQL APIs for CRUD operations on records (Core API) and schema management (Metadata API). The API is schema-per-tenant, dynamically generated based on custom objects and fields. Webhooks are also supported. No existing MCP server is mentioned.
buildability_verdict: yes, Twenty explicitly supports building AI agents. It allows creating custom agents, giving them access to CRM data, configuring their behavior, and executing them in workflows. Developers can extend Twenty with custom objects, server-side logic, UI components, and AI agents as TypeScript packages using the twenty-sdk.
